page.overview:
Who is Barsboldia?

(meaning "of Barsbold", a well-known Mongolian paleontologist) is an extinct genus of hadrosaur dinosaur that lived in Mongolia during the Late Cretaceous period. It was named after Rinchen Barsbold, a famous Mongolian paleontologist.

Barsboldia is part of the Saurolophinae subfamily, who were common in Asia during the Cretaceous period. The huge size of this duckbill indicates that the Gobi Desert was once a much different environment with lots of plants and water.

Some scientists proposed that Barsboldia isn't a valid genus and is a synonym to Hypacrosaurus. However, this isn't true nowaday due to the fact that Hypacrosaurus isn't a member of the Saurolophinae subfamily, and dinosaurs from Asia and North America, while being similar to each other, are different species as a whole.

Barsboldia was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia. It is inaccurately portrayed with a crest on its head, something that the real dinosaur didn't have.
